June, I replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-pod. The ticket is #8841, which Gideon said on 1 Jul he closed with support.

What fixed it: Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets. After that the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing dept, so they didn't need the custom CSV export. The channel doesn't give any more detail on the root cause.
